name: Release
description: Controlled CAPITAL-AI release lifecycle and fail-closed platform-version gate. package.json remains the platform-version source of truth; final Git tags are prohibited until production acceptance.

events.note: The version gate does not emit synthetic release events. EventMesh publication may be added only when a real release state transition is persisted.

note: ADR-0030 implementation: scripts/automation/releaseVersion.ts provides dry-run by default and requires explicit --apply for mutations. It validates exact next SemVer transitions, classification, work-package/ADR traceability, rollback and acceptance requirements; synchronizes package/lock/metadata/governed mirrors; runs lint, version consistency, build and predeploy gates; restores version files on failure; writes release-candidate evidence only after gates pass; and never creates a final Git tag.
